title: Evolution through the read sweep
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite alphabet, let $E$ inject the symbols of $\Gamma$ together with blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $e$ embed the binary alphabet into $\Gamma$. For a machine $M$ over $\Gamma$, a binary input $x$, a configuration $c$ of $M$ on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$, and a state $q$ with $c$ in state $q$, for every integer $j$ with $j\le N+1$, running the binary block-code simulator for $j$ steps from the encoded configuration of $c$ gives the read-sweep configuration of $c$ at counter $j$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is an embedding of symbols and blank into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits
$M$ is a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on the letterwise $e$-image of $x$
$q$ is a state of $M$ and $c$ is in state $q$
